title: Apple Inc.'s New iOS 11.3 Looks Like a Huge Update
text:
Apple Inc.'s 6.1-inch LCD iPhone Specs Revealed 
This fall, Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) is expected to launch three new iPhones. The first is expected to be a straightforward successor to this year's iPhone X -- think internal upgrades in a virtually identical form factor. The second is expected to simply be a larger version of the upgraded iPhone X. Apple Inc.'s New iOS 11.3 Looks Like a Huge Update 
Back in September 2017, Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) announced the newest version of its mobile operating system, known as iOS 11. The new iteration of iOS saw the addition of augmented reality-specific capabilities, a totally redesigned App Store, an enhanced version of Apple's Siri voice assistant, and improvements to Apple Music, Apple Maps, and Apple Pay.
